description: This file defines a PHP class 'Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Special_Variable' that compiles code related to special Smarty template variables within the Smarty template engine. It includes logic to handle various special variables like 'foreach', 'section', 'capture', 'now', 'cookies', 'get', 'post', etc., and generates PHP code accordingly.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Special_Variable
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling PHP code for special Smarty template variables.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles code for handling special Smarty variables based on the provided arguments and context.
